title: Edit, add, or delete a network connection with nmtui
summary: Modify the settings of an existing network connection, create a new one, or remove an old one using the text interface.

steps.explain: Open the editor for a specific connection to change its settings, or leave the name blank to add a new one.

placeholders.name: CONNECTION_NAME
placeholders.description: The name or ID of the connection to edit. Leave empty or use a new name to add a connection.

steps.expect: A form appears allowing you to edit connection details like SSID, password, or IP settings.

rollback.explain: To undo changes, you can delete the modified connection and recreate it, or restore from a backup if you have one. nmtui does not provide a direct 'undo' command.

warnings: Deleting a connection removes its saved settings (like passwords). Make sure you know the password before deleting.
